title: Derived scalar extension of a closed supported constant sheaf
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $i:D\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $N\geq1$ be an integer, put $\Lambda=(\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z)$, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$. In the ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the canonical comparison, adjoint to the coefficient unit $\Lambda_D\to A_D$, for the derived change-of-rings functor [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] along $\Lambda_T\to A_T$ identifies $Ri_*\Lambda_D\otimes_{\Lambda_T}^{\mathbf L}A_T$ with $Ri_*A_D$, where direct image is [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], inverse image and constant sheaves are as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and derived tensor is [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Under this identification the map induced from $\Lambda_T\to i_*\Lambda_D$ is the unit $A_T\to Ri_*A_D$. The identification is valid without flatness of $A$ over $\Lambda$.

The statement is true, unchanged, and keeps the ordinary etale module category with change of rings along Lambda_T -> A_T. It needs no Cartier hypothesis, no invertibility of N and no flatness. I tested D empty, D=T, N=1, A=0, Lambda=Z/4 with A=Z/2, and a nonreduced D. Steps 1-6 check out. A closed immersion is finite (R/I is generated by 1), so the stalks of i_*Lambda_D are Lambda or 0. i_* is exact (sk-lem-pbc-finite) and therefore computes Ri_* (lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor). E[0] is K-flat by a direct stalk argument. m is the unique A_T-linear extension of c and is an iso on stalks. The identity K-flat resolution in lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings (2) gives the derived map, and the unit equation is elementary. One gap is repaired (C3/E5): step 3 applied lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar, stated for the tensor over Lambda, to the tensor over Lambda_T used by def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product and def-pc-kflat-complex. I added the identification: the presheaf surjection is an iso on stalks because (Lambda_T)_t = Lambda and colimits commute with tensor, so conservativity applies. The step is now 1433 characters, with no new citations.
